Reformed.profile: UK (London-based) functional-beverage brand — premium coffee and ceremonial matcha fortified with added nutrients (collagen or vegan collagen, creatine, 21 vitamins/minerals). Add-on line includes creatine powder, fiber powder, functional mushrooms (Lion's Mane, Tremella), and ashwagandha. All-natural, gluten-free, dairy-free, no artificial sweeteners/added sugar. Founded 2024 by Neil Saada and Neil Marrakchi. Added directly by Pavel 2026-08-10 (not yet independently discovered via the weekly scan) — treat as an anchor going forward.

key_facts.fact: 118,000+ customer reviews at time of check; stocked at premium UK retailers (Selfridges, SILO, MAD) and available via delivery services (Zapp).

Backfilled 2026-09-14 (a gap missed at the brand's 2026-08-10 library addition): closed a $22M Series A led by IRIS Ventures (JamJar Investments, V3, FoodLabs participating), oversubscribed. Scaled profitably to $70M ARR within two years on a ~14-person team; funds earmarked for leadership hires and a Q3 2026 US launch, targeting $100M revenue run-rate by end of 2026.

Gruns.profile: Daily greens gummy brand, founded 2023 by Chad Janis. Scaled to $300M ARR in under 4 years; 95% of customers use the product 4-6x/week; ships 10M gummies/day; in 7,000 retail doors. Product line expanded with Grüns Kids (2024), Nütrops (cognitive, 2024), Immün (immune, 2025), Jüced (energy, 2025).

key_facts.fact: Acquired by Unilever for $1.2B, expanding Unilever's health/wellbeing portfolio — Unilever's first acquisition since its food-business/McCormick merger announcement.

Background (pre-window, surfaced 2026-10-05 run): proposed class action (Ulberg et al. v. Gruns Nutrition, Inc. et al., D.N.J., case 2:26-cv-11269) alleges deceptive 'sugar-free' labeling over allulose content, naming both Gruns and Unilever.

IM8.profile: David Beckham-backed longevity/health-drink brand under parent Prenetics. Flagship product: Daily Ultimate Essentials. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-08-17 run — see key_facts for the full growth trajectory.

key_facts.fact: $120M ARR in 12 months post-launch (+480% YoY), disclosed in Prenetics' Q4/FY2025 results.
Q1 2026 revenue $33.8M (~6x YoY).

Section 2 Brand Spotlight: full profile compiled — General Catalyst's $1B non-dilutive 'Customer Value Fund' (closed Jul 14, 2026) funds up to 70% of marketing spend per monthly cohort, repaid only from that cohort's revenue; quarterly-subscription retention model; sold in 43 countries with 60%+ revenue outside the US; ~4-star Trustpilot with complaints on shipping delays and per-serving cost (~$3.30, ~$2.63 subscribed); no lawsuits/FTC action found.
Launched Daily Ultimate Essentials PRO with two new flavors (Mango + Passionfruit, Lemon + Orange).
Partnered with Vitamin Angels, committing to impact 400,000 mothers/children in year one against malnutrition.
Named exclusive Official Health Supplements Partner of Inter Miami CF (multi-year).
Preliminary unaudited monthly revenue ~$17M in June; FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $210-220M.
Parent Prenetics closed $1B in growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund.
Prenetics separately projects IM8 reaching ~$300M in annualized run-rate revenue by year-end 2026 and >$400M full-year revenue in 2027.

Prenetics raised FY2026 IM8 revenue guidance to $210-220M (from $190-210M), its second guidance raise this year, forecasting a $300M annualized run-rate by year-end; disclosed alongside its Aug 18 Q2-earnings-date announcement.

Q2 2026 results: total revenue $46.5M (+288% YoY), IM8 revenue $45.0M (+359% YoY, ~$20.9M in July alone) — sixth consecutive record quarter. Gross margin 65%; loss from operations $20.98M; adjusted EBITDA -$19.03M. FY2026 IM8 guidance raised to $220-230M (from $210-220M); new $400M+ FY27 target. July was Prenetics' first month of positive consolidated adjusted free cash flow.

Holy.profile: Berlin-founded (2020) DTC functional beverage brand — powdered energy drinks, hydration mixes, iced teas in sachet/tub format, mixed at home. Positions against canned incumbents (Monster, Red Bull) on cost/shipping-weight economics.

key_facts.fact: In 6,000+ stores across Germany and Austria (Rewe, Edeka), 2.5M+ fans across Europe.
Investing £10M to break into UK retail; London ops team led by Dan Macken, hired ex-Monster Energy exec Ben Pegram.
Flavor/formulation partnership with Symrise.

Arrae.profile: Women's wellness / gut-health-and-mood supplement brand founded by husband-and-wife team Siff Haider and Nish Samantray in March 2020 (Toronto/NYC). Built on a tight SKU count (~8-10 hero products spanning gut, cortisol/stress, mood, menopause). Reached $100M+ revenue largely bootstrapped — self-funded to $1M revenue within ~8 months, no outside capital until a comparatively small later seed round. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-08-03 run.

key_facts.fact: Crossed $100M revenue.
Rolled out into Ulta.
+460% YTD retail-distribution growth in 2026.
Went nationwide at Sprouts Farmers Market; became top-selling women's supplement in Sprouts' innovation-center program.
Signed Pamela Anderson as a partner/face for a midlife/perimenopause-focused push, extending beyond its Gen Z/Millennial TikTok base.
Went nationwide at Target.

Balance note: Trustpilot score 1.9/5 across 145+ reviews — recurring complaints on product efficacy, subscription/billing transparency, and slow shipping. No lawsuit/FTC action found specific to Arrae.

Arrae.geography: US (DTC ships US/Canada/international; physical retail US-only so far)

Icle Time.profile: Height-growth supplement brand (Premium Alpha / Premium Pro lines).

key_facts.fact: Relaunched two products: Height Growth Premium Alpha and Premium Pro.
Surpassed 980,000 cumulative customers.

Trimoryn.profile: Once-daily capsule for women over 40, targeting metabolism, appetite awareness, and gut wellness (plant compounds, fiber, targeted probiotic strains).

key_facts.fact: Published updated 2026 product information / official introduction.

Zesty Paws.profile: Pet supplement brand (part of H&H Group).

key_facts.fact: Expanded into the veterinary channel with Zesty Paws Professional line, distributed via epiq Animal Health.
Expanded into ~1,200 Publix stores across the Southeast US.
Cat Calming Diffuser (pheromone-based, non-sedative) named "Cat Calming Product of the Year" in the 2026 Pet Innovation Awards.

PetLab Co..profile: London-based pet supplement brand, founded 2018 by Christopher Masanto. ~185 employees as of Apr 2026.

key_facts.fact: BC Partners acquired a majority stake.

DogSuppy.profile: Dog supplement brand based in Kortrijk, Belgium (legal entity Suppy BV). 100%-natural daily chewies for gut flora, skin/coat, teeth, joints, anal glands, and stress/behavior — gluten-free, grain-free. Sells direct via dogsuppy.com and dogsuppy.co.uk, active mainly in Benelux/UK. Resolved 2026-07-26 after being unidentifiable as 'Dog Supply Co.' in prior runs.

key_facts.fact: ~41.3K monthly site visitors, est. $89K-$162K monthly revenue, 288 active Meta ads, 61 products listed — an active, ad-spending DTC operator, not a dormant brand.
Exhibited at Animo 2026 (Benelux pet trade show); described the appearance as a strong success.

New disambiguation flag (same pattern as Balto): a seemingly distinct 'DogSuppy' storefront exists in Poland (dogsuppy.pl, sells via Allegro, natural dog supplements for anti-itch/dental/joint/mobility, '10+ years' claimed) -- unclear if a market-specific storefront of the tracked Belgian entity (Suppy BV) or an unrelated Polish company trading under the same name. Flagged for investigation, not resolved.

Finn.profile: NYC-based dog supplement brand, founded 2020 by James Shalhoub. ~11 employees as of May 2026. Product line: probiotics + multivitamins.

Balto.profile: Limited public info found so far on baltousa.com, which reads as primarily an orthopedic-bracing brand (knee/elbow/carpal braces for arthritis, CCL tears, hip dysplasia), not a nutritional supplement brand — worth revisiting whether it's the right anchor for this pet-supplement watch list. ESCALATED 2026-09-07: a second, distinct 'Balto' also exists — a French/Benelux-market canine joint-health supplement (omega-3/EPA/DHA/vitamin E for osteoarthritis) sold under the Artonova brand via ortopetshop.com, unrelated to baltousa.com. Two different companies use the name in the pet space. Recommend a decision next run: split into two entries (Balto USA = bracing, Balto/Artonova EU = supplement) or replace baltousa.com as the anchor if it was never actually a supplement brand.

key_facts.fact: Cross-brand promotion with HealthyBud ("Calm + Support" pairing HealthyBud Calming Aid with Balto Bracing).
key_facts.source: unconfirmed — surfaced via aggregator, not a primary source

key_facts.fact: Identified a separate, unrelated 'Balto' (Artonova) product — a canine joint-health/osteoarthritis supplement sold in France/Benelux via ortopetshop.com. Distinct legal entity/product from baltousa.com's bracing line.

Balto.geography: unknown (baltousa.com: US bracing); Balto/Artonova: France/Benelux supplement

Wuffes.profile: Dog supplement brand pursuing aggressive 2026 omnichannel retail expansion.

key_facts.fact: Launched nationwide at Petco.
Full range available in 1,300+ PetSmart stores.
Landed in all 199 Pet Supermarket locations.

Paws & Whiskers.profile: US vet-formulated dog-supplement brand (mobility, digestion, joint, everyday wellness), co-founded by "Matt" after his German Shepherd Hans battled liver cancer and arthritis; formulas developed with Dr. Petar Petrov, DVM (20+ years animal-nutrition experience). Manufactured in FDA-registered, GMP-certified US facilities; free of soy, corn, artificial preservatives/flavors.

key_facts.fact: Launched in the US, syndicated across local-news press-release wires and openpr.com; confirmed still the same brand re-surfacing in the 2026-09-07 discovery scan (no news since launch).

Prefera Pet Food UK (Bound).profile: UK pet food company; "Bound" is its liquid pet-supplement line (pump format) for dogs and cats — probiotic, joint, skin/coat, calming, immunity.

key_facts.fact: Launched the Bound liquid supplement range.

Create Wellness.profile: Creatine monohydrate gummy brand founded Dec 2022 by Dan and Sienna McCormick (ex-Away, Parade, Not Boring; ex-Goldman Sachs). First-mover on a gummy format for creatine, a category traditionally sold as powder/capsule. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-07-27 run.

key_facts.fact: Raised $20M Series B (Alliance Consumer Growth led; Impact Capital and existing investor Unilever Ventures participated) to expand retail presence and creatine-supplement marketing. Prior raise: $5M Series A (2024, Unilever Ventures).
Nationwide retail rollout into Target, The Vitamin Shoppe, and Sprouts; became top-selling creatine gummy at each retailer since launch.

Sold 250M+ gummies (~83M servings); team scaled from 5 full-time staff (late 2025) to 25; $30-40M in 2026 marketing spend planned. Influencer/UGC seeding via agency Kynship (~1,000 creators) reports 263% new-customer revenue growth from the program.
Class action filed (Connolly v. Create Wellness, SDNY) alleging gummies contain ~10% less creatine than the labeled 4.5g/serving; company disputes, citing third-party Eurofins potency testing.
Launched a new 'Sour Grape' flavor.
Expanded its Creatine + Electrolytes Mix line with a new 'Lemonade Collection' (5g creatine, 800mg electrolytes, 1000mg taurine per stick).

Create Wellness.geography: US (DTC + mass/specialty retail; no international expansion reported)

Vitabiotics.profile: UK's No.1 vitamin brand (VB Group), founded/led by Tej Lalvani (ex-Dragons' Den investor). Portfolio includes Pregnacare, Wellman, Wellwoman, Perfectil, and Osteocare. Group also includes Meyer Organics (India) and VB Egypt.

key_facts.fact: Bain Capital (Asia PE team) agreed to acquire the VB Group for ~$1.2B/£900M (deal-value figures vary by outlet, $850-900M to $1.2B); Lalvani stays on as CEO. EQT and TPG had also bid. Bain plans to invest in e-commerce, digital, and international distribution, targeting India, the Middle East, and China.

Vitabiotics.geography: UK, with operations in India (Meyer Organics) and Egypt (VB Egypt)

Myota.profile: UK gut-health/microbiome startup (London), founded 2019/2022 by computational biologist Thomas Gurry and Kat Stennett. Clinically-backed prebiotic fibre blends, sold both DTC and B2B (supplies Joe & The Juice).

key_facts.fact: Closed a $4.5M Series A led by PeakBridge (reported July 2, 2026).

Happy V.profile: Founder-led women's health probiotics brand; broke out via organic TikTok virality.

key_facts.fact: 500,000+ customers served, $20M+ in sales attributed to a viral TikTok video about bacterial vaginosis.

Plant People.profile: Adaptogen/mushroom functional gummy brand; bootstrapped and profitable for 7 years before taking outside capital.

key_facts.fact: Took its first institutional capital — a minority-stake investment from PE firm Manna Tree, with Unilever Ventures participating.
CEO outlined growth strategy following the Manna Tree minority investment.

Valerie.profile: UK perimenopause supplement brand, London, founded 2024 by Wizz Selvey and Olly Johnson. Flagship 'Daily Essential' is a liposomal all-in-one (ashwagandha, B vitamins, zinc, magnesium) for mood/energy/focus. ~80% gross margin, £70+ AOV. Stocked at Liberty and Holland & Barrett. Previously raised £514K pre-seed (backers incl. Giles Brook, ex-Vita Coco EMEA CEO).

key_facts.fact: Put up for sale by founders after a follow-on funding round fell through.

DITTO.profile: Menstrual/PMS supplement brand, scientist-founded (neuroscientist Alice van der Schoot + former L'Oreal Brand Director Adam Kugler). Flagship 'Premenstrual Daily' (omega-3, magnesium, saffron via time-released beadlet delivery) targets PMS/PMDD. Note: a same-named, unrelated Rotterdam AI-health-summary startup also raised money in 2026 — confirmed distinct companies.

key_facts.fact: Closed a €5.2M ($6M) seed round led by FoodLabs with EKA Ventures and angels (total funding ~$7.7M), earmarked for PMDD/ADHD clinical research.

Plainspeak.profile: New women's supplement brand; flagship 'Strength Water' (protein/creatine/collagen blend). Notable for an unusual acquisition tactic: skipping paid ads in favor of mailing physical sample sachets to people who DM their address on Instagram.

key_facts.fact: Profiled by Modern Retail for its mail-in-sample acquisition strategy.

Omni Pet (LeanPaws).profile: London B-Corp backed by Deborah Meaden (Dragons' Den). LeanPaws is a non-prescription, plant-based dog weight-loss supplement designed to mimic GLP-1/Ozempic mechanisms (fibres, resistant starches, pre/probiotics); trial claimed 77% of overweight dogs lost weight.

key_facts.fact: Raised £11M ($14.5M) Series A (IW Capital/Redrice Ventures led, with RootBridge, Digitalis Ventures, Lever VC) to fund US entry and UK supermarket rollout.

Bloom Nutrition.profile: Founded 2019 by fitness-influencer Mari Llewellyn and CEO Greg LaVecchia. Started as a single-SKU greens-and-superfoods powder, evolved into a multi-category beverage-and-wellness platform (greens, Sparkling Energy drink, Bloom Pop prebiotic soda, Colostrum & Collagen Peptides). On pace for ~$500M in 2026 revenue, publicly framing its trajectory toward $1B. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-08-10 run.

key_facts.fact: Nutrabolt (maker of C4) took a 20% minority stake for $90M.
Bloom Pop (prebiotic/gut-health soda) launched exclusively at 3,000+ Walmart stores nationwide.
Expanded into Ulta Beauty (300 stores).
Nutrabolt invested an additional ~$160M, taking majority ownership at a total commitment of ~$210M.
Forbes feature: on pace for ~$500M 2026 revenue, trajectory toward $1B; beverage arm on track to surpass original supplement business this year.

Bloom Nutrition.geography: US (DTC + national mass retail; no material international expansion found)

Thorne.profile: Premium/clinical-grade supplement brand, owned by L Catterton (went private 2023).

key_facts.fact: P&G agreed to acquire Thorne for $3.8B, beating out Unilever and Haleon. Thorne surpassed $500M revenue in 2025, on pace for ~$650M in 2026 (~30%+ CAGR since going private); ~60% of revenue now from under-40 consumers. Deal expected to close Q4 2026.

Ritual.profile: Women's-health-focused supplement brand; Essential Prenatal is its #1 top-selling product.

key_facts.fact: Essential Prenatal expanded from a ~200-store West Coast Costco footprint (since Feb 2026) to nationwide across all US Costco warehouses (in-store, online, same-day delivery), $48.99 two-pack.

Q2 2026 net sales $1.33B (+5.4% YoY) but a net loss of $(26.3)M vs. prior-year profit. Announced CFO John DeSimone's planned retirement (effective Dec 31, 2026), succeeded by Scott Schaefer (former Zappos President/CEO) effective Jan 1, 2027.

Blackmores.profile: Established Australian vitamin/supplement brand, active in APAC markets.

key_facts.fact: Launched "FiZZERS," a fast-dissolving microgranule supplement format (drinkable, chewable, or effervescent) aimed at younger consumers, debuting in Singapore with regional rollout planned.

CaniNectar.profile: By Tharos Ltd (UK), founded by William Addison and Dr. Rosemary Waring. Patented barley-derived natural enzyme supplement for dogs using an "anabiomics" approach — optimizing the dog's existing gut microbiome rather than introducing foreign bacterial strains. Builds on prior equine research behind sister product EquiNectar.

key_facts.fact: Featured in a Pet Food Industry trend piece on anabiomics as a new direction in animal gut health.

Botanical Bones.profile: Vet-co-founded functional dog-treat brand positioning treats as a "targeted health-support platform," using organic, clinically dosed botanicals.

key_facts.fact: Profiled by Pet Food Processing; exact publish date approximate (direct fetch unavailable).

Holistic Way.profile: Established Singapore supplement brand (JR Life Sciences Pte Ltd, founded 2007 by Ricky Ong) — not a startup, but new to our tracking library.

key_facts.fact: Launched a plant-based Menopause Relief supplement (three clinically studied phytoestrogens, hormone-free, vegan/vegetarian-friendly).

NORTH Performance.profile: All-in-one performance-supplement brand co-founded by Michael Lucas and Uri Kurop (surfers/snowboarders who developed joint damage) with orthopedic surgeon Dr. Masi Reynolds, DO (co-founder, Silicon Valley Orthopedics). Two flagship products: Foundation (effervescent daily tablet) and Ultra (advanced stack). Novel model: ~30 founding action-sports athletes (Brandon Semenuk, Brett Rheeder, Loïc Bruni, Danny MacAskill, and others) hold real equity as co-owners instead of paid-ambassador deals. NSF-certified manufacturing in Lindon, UT.

key_facts.fact: Launched globally with a pre-sales site and the founding athlete co-owner roster; full purchase/shipping launch slated for September 2026.

NORTH Performance.geography: US (Dover, DE incorporation; Lindon, UT manufacturing)

Mervyn's Petcare.profile: US subsidiary of Yuyu Pharma (Korean pharmaceutical company), operating the "Feline First" cat-supplement line. A portfolio company of UCLA's Magnify Incubator (California NanoSystems Institute).

key_facts.fact: Launched its second Feline First product — Ari's Purrfect Omega+Multivitamin Lickable Cat Food Supplement — on Amazon, timed to its one-year Magnify Incubator anniversary.

FitLife Brands.profile: Public sports-nutrition/supplement holding company; owns Irwin Naturals (acquired brand driving current growth).

key_facts.fact: Q2 2026 total revenue $26.5M (+65% YoY); wholesale revenue +156% to $14.6M; net income $2.0M (+12%). Growth driven by Irwin Naturals, whose Amazon channel reached ~$1M/month by June 2026.

AG1.profile: Daily greens/foundational-nutrition powder brand (formerly Athletic Greens).

key_facts.fact: Signed its first-ever football sponsorship: multi-season Championship front-of-shirt deal with Swansea City FC (2026-27), branding across kits, stadium, and digital. Club co-owned by Luka Modrić, Snoop Dogg, and Martha Stewart.

AG1.geography: US, UK marketing push via Swansea sponsorship

Jamieson Wellness.profile: Canadian vitamin/supplement company, publicly traded prior to acquisition.

key_facts.fact: Kirin Holdings agreed to acquire Jamieson Wellness for ~C$2.5B (~$1.4B USD), C$45.75/share all-cash deal; closing expected Q4 2026. Explicit play for a North American health-science platform. Backfilled this run — missed the prior week's window by a few days.

Arrival Wellness.profile: Women-founded US creatine brand (launched April 2025) built around a single hero product — creatine monohydrate + organic blueberry, third-party tested, '2-ingredient' positioning.

key_facts.fact: Launched single-serve travel sachets of its daily creatine ($3 single / $28 12-pack); official launch Aug 25, 2026.

LibraHealth.profile: South Korean menstrual-cycle-tailored sports-nutrition brand for female athletes. Flagship product 'Golden' (named for the corpus luteum/luteal phase) combines kimchi-derived lactic acid bacteria with plant-based ingredients; deliberately avoids hormone-active ingredients.

key_facts.fact: Raised an undisclosed seed round from Korean VC The Ventures, earmarked for product development/certification and a Q4 2026 pilot supply to US collegiate sports teams ahead of a Q1 2027 official launch.

Micro Ingredients.profile: Diamond Bar, CA supplement brand (legal entity DPL Trading Inc.), founded ~2015-16 by Sara Lyu. Started as an Amazon-first organic-spice/superfood-powder seller, now expanding into collagen, ashwagandha, mushroom, and fiber supplements. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-08-24 run — see key_facts for full growth trajectory.

key_facts.fact: #1 supplement brand on TikTok Shop, ~$31.2M in sales YTD (Charm.io data), ahead of MaryRuth's ($27.9M) and Goli Nutrition ($20M). Passed $111.7M cumulative TikTok Shop GMV (3.2M units, 117K+ creator videos), after crossing $50M cumulative in Oct 2024 and $63.4M full-year 2024.

Class action filed (Willis-Albrigo v. DPL Trading, Inc., C.D. Cal.) alleging false '10g protein' labeling on Pure Peanut Powder; separate CA Prop 65 60-day notice over lead/cadmium in powdered products. No FDA recall issued.

Micro Ingredients.geography: US (Amazon + TikTok Shop US; no confirmed international retail)

Applied Nutrition.profile: UK publicly-traded sports-nutrition/supplement company (LSE: APN), founded 2014 by Thomas Ryder; went public October 2024. Coleen Rooney is both an investor and brand ambassador. Section 1 headline, 2026-08-31 run.

key_facts.fact: FY26 (year ended Jul 31, 2026) revenue £160M (+50% YoY, beat £148.4M consensus); adjusted EBITDA ~£43.3M (+40% YoY, also ahead of consensus). Net cash £15.9M after Nutrablend trade-and-assets acquisition (US manufacturing platform). FY27 guidance: revenue ~£205M, adjusted EBITDA ~£49M (+13%), though whey protein cost inflation expected to compress margin slightly. Market cap ~£853M six months prior; would cross £1bn at a 400p share price.

North American licensing deal with Mondelez International (Sour Patch Kids / Swedish Fish co-branded sports-nutrition line via its ABE brand), rolling out to ~2,200 Walmart and ~1,300 GNC locations; full GNC availability Sept 1, 2026.

Applied Nutrition.geography: UK, with US manufacturing (Nutrablend) and North American retail (Walmart, GNC)

Host Defense.profile: Established functional-mushroom human-supplement brand (Fungi Perfecti) making its first entry into pet supplements.

key_facts.fact: Launched Immune & Whole-Body Support, a daily mushroom-mycelium powder for dogs/cats (Lion's Mane, Reishi, Turkey Tail, Chaga, Maitake), grown on the company's own Pacific Northwest farm. Available at HostDefense.com and participating retailers nationwide.

O Positiv Health.profile: Women's wellness supplement brand (prior known product: Willo hair-growth capsules); expanding its hair-health line.

key_facts.fact: Launched URO Hair Growth + Volume, a once-daily capsule targeting hair thinning/shedding (featuring Serevelle), DTC-exclusive at opositiv.com, $36.99.

Mila.profile: Female-founded (Kim Aviv, Ada Trujillo) design-led intimate/sexual-wellness brand. Products include patent-pending Aura device and Bloom hydrating intimate mist.

key_facts.fact: Raised an oversubscribed $2.5M pre-seed (Mensch VC-led, with Sticker Ventures and angels from Spotify/Dyson/Tetra Pak/BrewDog); expanding into Ulta Beauty, Whole Foods, and The Vitamin Shoppe; targeting $40M in 2026 sales.

Cymbiotika.profile: San Diego liposomal-supplement brand, co-founded 2019 by Shahab and Durana Elmi (building on a company originally started by Chervin Jafarieh in 2018). Bootstrapped to $150M 2025 revenue before raising outside capital. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-08-31 run — see key_facts for full growth trajectory.

key_facts.fact: Reached $150M in annual revenue, fully bootstrapped with no outside capital.
Raised a $25M seed round from celebrity-fan investors (Kendall Jenner, Hailey Bieber, The Weeknd, Zac Efron, Steve Aoki, the Jonas Brothers); guiding to $250M revenue in its seventh year (2026).
Nationwide launch at Target (largest retail expansion to date, first big-box entry) followed by Ulta Beauty launch.
Launched at Whole Foods Market nationwide; total retail footprint now exceeds 3,500 locations globally.

TikTok/Instagram influencer Alix Earle (14M+ followers) took an equity stake after years of organic product use; will create education-driven content across TikTok/Instagram/YouTube, with a possible co-branded product to follow.

Balance note: Trustpilot shows mixed sentiment (792 reviews) with recurring complaints on subscription-cancellation friction and shipping-seal damage. No lawsuit/FTC action found. International: UK e-commerce since 2022, UAE since May 2023, EU named by CEO as the brand's next major expansion target.

Cymbiotika.geography: US (San Diego HQ); UK, UAE live; EU expansion targeted

Nature's Bounty.profile: Legacy mainstream vitamin/supplement brand, part of Nestlé's Health Science portfolio. Section 1 headline, 2026-09-07 run — Nestlé is divesting it along with Osteo Bi-Flex, Ester-C, Gard, Nuun, Puritan's Pride, Sisu, and its US private-label supplements business to PE firm Yellow Wood Partners for ~$1B. Nestlé retains its premium lines (Solgar, Pure Encapsulations).

key_facts.fact: Nestlé agreed to divest 7 mainstream vitamin/supplement brands (Nature's Bounty, Osteo Bi-Flex, Ester-C, Gard, Nuun, Puritan's Pride, Sisu) plus its US private-label supplements business and related manufacturing/distribution to Yellow Wood Partners for ~$1B. Divested portfolio did $1.2B in 2025 sales. Deal expected to close H1 2027.

Twinlab.profile: Legacy sports-nutrition/supplement brand (with sister brands Reserveage, Metabolife, Alvita Tea), reaches 50,000 retail outlets including GNC and Vitamin Shoppe. Section 1 headline, 2026-09-07 run — being acquired by cbdMD.

key_facts.fact: cbdMD entered a definitive agreement to acquire Twinlab, Reserveage, Metabolife, and Alvita Tea (~$30M combined TTM revenue, a ~40% lift to cbdMD's standalone revenue). Deal proceeds via an assignment-for-benefit-of-creditors process, subject to court approval.

Momentous.profile: Park City/Jackson-based performance-supplement brand founded 2016 by former NFL lineman Jeff Byers and Rob Dyrdek. Differentiates via NSF Certified for Sport status across its full 50+ SKU line, DoD-backed research grants, and B2B/team-supply distribution (200+ pro/collegiate teams, NFL clubs, USA Rugby) alongside DTC subscriptions. Grew rapidly off a 2022 Huberman Lab podcast partnership and is now expanding into national retail (Vitamin Shoppe) after years as primarily direct-to-consumer. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-09-07 run.

key_facts.fact: Ranked No. 426 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 with 821% three-year revenue growth; fourth consecutive year on the list.
Announced exclusive nationwide retail rollout into The Vitamin Shoppe and Super Supplements (640+ locations), a shift from DTC-only toward omnichannel.
Self-reported >$1M spent in 2025 on third-party testing/NSF certification; scrapped non-compliant lots of tongkat ali, ashwagandha, and collagen shot.
Became official supplement partner of USA Rugby (men's and women's national teams).

Entered multi-year partnership with Huberman Lab podcast; Dr. Andrew Huberman joined as scientific advisor — widely credited (industry commentary, not company-confirmed) with an early step-change in sales.
Received strategic investment from Humble Growth (~$32M reported); total funding to date ~$43.6M, modest relative to the growth claimed.

Balance note: Trustpilot reviews polarized — recurring complaints on premium pricing (~$1/serving above category average) and subscription/international shipping friction. No FTC action or lawsuit found. Current-year total revenue could not be independently verified.

Momentous.geography: US (primary); UK via distributors Vielo/Healf; Canada via Cascade Gear/HLC

PetDomain.profile: Family-owned veterinary-formulated pet-supplement maker, operating under the ThorneVet name for 25 years before rebranding to PetDomain and launching a consumer-facing identity Aug 4, 2026. Led by Kim and Alex Pearson, who took over ThorneVet's operations in 2019 and have run it independently of Thorne (the human-supplement brand, acquired separately by new ownership in 2023) ever since — the two brands share pre-2019 history but are now unrelated companies. Section 1a discovery, 2026-09-14 run.

key_facts.fact: Rebrand and consumer launch: 38 veterinarian-formulated products (joint health, longevity, digestive, calming), GMP-certified manufacturing in Vermont, independently lab-verified, used by 1,100+ veterinarians.

Pemi.profile: New women-founded DTC wellness brand targeting perimenopause specifically. Flagship line: three oral dissolving strips (mood, mental clarity, sleep) using clinically studied ingredients. Section 1a discovery, 2026-09-14 run.

key_facts.fact: Official launch, shipping direct-to-consumer across the US.

Native Pet.profile: St. Louis clean-label pet-supplement brand founded 2017 by childhood friends Dan Schaefer (CEO) and Pat Barron. Flagship product The Daily (mobility/energy/gut/skin-coat chew) earned Clean Label Project certification in 2025 (150+ contaminants tested). Built digital-first before entering physical retail in early 2024 (Tractor Supply), since expanded to PetSmart, Target, CVS, and specialty/natural grocery — 13,000+ retail locations total, alongside Amazon/Chewy/Thrive Market DTC. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-09-14 run — first pet-supplement brand used for this section (all prior spotlights were human-supplement brands).

key_facts.fact: Ranked No. 890 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 with 390.7% three-year revenue growth.
$11M Series B led by CAVU Consumer Partners (other investors include Mars Inc., Starshot Ventures, Ando Consulting Group, Passive Impact); total funding to date ~$30.5M.
Hired its first-ever Chief Marketing Officer (Ariel Stoddard), described as a deliberate step from category challenger to fully scaled consumer brand.

Balance note: mixed Trustpilot reviews — recurring complaints on customer-service responsiveness, order fulfillment, and subscription-billing friction (one cited case: $272.99 charged for an unfulfilled order, partially refunded after 2 weeks), alongside genuine efficacy complaints on some SKUs (calming gummies, some probiotics) mixed with strongly positive results reported for others. No lawsuit/FTC action found.

Launched its first cat supplement line (Hairball, Multivitamin, Probiotic, Immune, Calm chews) in a dual-texture chicken format, first new species category since the brand's 2017 founding; nationwide Petco rollout to follow Oct 19, 2026.

Native Pet.geography: US (no international retail or DTC expansion found)

Fera Pets.profile: Pet-supplement brand acquired by General Mills in 2023 (undisclosed amount), operated as part of General Mills' pet-nutrition/growth-fund initiatives. Sells supplements for dogs and cats direct via ferapets.com and Amazon.

key_facts.fact: Launched 'Longevity for Dogs,' a daily soft chew targeting mitochondrial function, brain health, and cellular resilience — active ingredients include NMN (NAD+ precursor), MitoPrime ergothioneine, phosphatidylserine, resveratrol, and MCT oil. Coverage recirculated in PetfoodIndustry's Sept 11-17, 2026 weekly digest, which is how this run's discovery scan surfaced it.

MOSH.profile: Brain-health nutrition bar brand co-founded 2021 by Maria Shriver and Patrick Schwarzenegger (name = 'Maria Owings Shriver Health'). Two years DTC-only before entering retail. Portion of every purchase funds Alzheimer's research at the Women's Alzheimer's Movement at Cleveland Clinic (Shriver's father had the disease). Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-09-21 run. Note: a same-named, unrelated Australian brand (getmosh.com.au) exists.

key_facts.fact: DTC-only sales rose 70%+ in each of its first two years, reaching ~$12M revenue on 2.5M+ bars sold.

Raised $13M Series A led by Main Street Advisors to scale into national grocery. Crossed 2,000+ US retail doors; retail footprint on track to triple in 2026 toward a 5,000-door year-end target. Target launch confirmed for May 2026, alongside Sprouts, Albertsons, Kroger, H-E-B.
Balance note: mixed reviews (taste/quality praised, subscription billing/customer-service complaints); no lawsuits or FTC action found.

MOSH.geography: US (DTC + national grocery retail; no international expansion found)

Nutrafol.profile: Hair-growth supplement brand, majority-owned by Unilever since 2022. #1 dermatologist-recommended hair-growth supplement. Distribution model is unusual for the category: primary channel is a network of 3,000+ dermatologists/plastic surgeons/stylists who directly dispense the product at 'physician pricing,' supplemented by DTC/omnichannel retail (Ulta Beauty) rather than pure DTC. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-09-28 run.

key_facts.fact: Crossed $1B in annual sales, valued at ~$3.5B (Forbes exclusive with CEO Cindy Gustafson). Online-store sales alone ~$95M in 2025 (up double digits YoY) -- a small fraction of total revenue, which is majority direct-to-physician/omnichannel. International expansion planned to be 'exceptionally methodical,' seeded via physician networks; first international doctor's-office placement targeted by end of 2026.

First hair-growth supplement to earn NSF Certified for Sport status; signed multi-year partnership with MLB as official hair-growth partner ('Hats Off' postseason campaign, continuing 2026 as 'The Long Game').

Balance note: TINA.org filed an FTC/FDA complaint over 'clinically proven' claims and undisclosed influencer relationships (30+ flagged ads), feeding a subsequent class-action lawsuit alleging deceptive marketing. Trustpilot reviews mixed -- recurring complaints on price (~$88/month) and chat-only cancellation friction.

Nutrafol.geography: US (majority of revenue); international expansion planned via physician-network seeding

VALR Brand.profile: Sports-nutrition energy-drink brand, founded/led by industry veteran Bryan Alesiano (ex-Celsius, ex-Glanbia Performance Nutrition). Expanded into supplements with Creatine+, a 7-in-1 formula.

key_facts.fact: Launched Creatine+ (5g micronized creatine monohydrate, HMB, L-glutamine, betaine, vitamin D3/K2, AstraGin). Distribution via fitness/vitamin-specialty/military retail, DTC, Amazon, and TikTok Shop.

Apoth\u00e9kary.profile: Herbal tincture/supplement brand founded 2020, positioning products as replacements for daily habits (caffeine, alcohol) -- targets energy, digestion, sleep, stress. Distribution includes Ulta Beauty, Whole Foods, The Vitamin Shoppe, Free People, Sprouts.

key_facts.fact: Raised $16M (Series A: $10M VC + $6M debt financing); investors include Shiseido (via LIFT venture arm), NextLevel Management, RSF Social Finance, ~50 angels. Targeting $40M 2026 sales (30-40% YoY growth).

Other Half.profile: Science-first pet wellness brand, founded by AJ Patel (founder of Zesty Paws, sold to H&H Group in 2021) and Mike Watts. Launched Nov 2024 with flagship products Everyday and Doggie Dental. Sold DTC and Amazon.

key_facts.fact: Raised $3M seed round led by Willow Growth, with Habitat Partners and Off Leash Capital (Chicago Pacific Founders) participating. Reported thousands of new monthly customers, repeat purchasers growing +25% MoM.

Pawd.profile: UK (London) dog-anxiety calming drink/supplement brand, launched March 2024. 900+ active monthly subscribers as of early 2026, targeting 10,000 over 12 months; planning US launch, forecasting profitability by Q3 2026.

key_facts.fact: Raised £400K seed round from angel investors (media personalities, PE partners, FMCG founders), on top of a £300K 2023 pre-seed. Exploring a further £200K top-up.

Oh Norman!.profile: Pet wellness brand co-founded by actress Kaley Cuoco, launched 2023, named after her late dog. Best-selling product is calming supplement 'Calm the Eff Down!'. Sold at Chewy (partnership since April 2025); a portion of every purchase supports dog rescue.

key_facts.fact: Raised $2.08M (oversubscribed 39%), bringing total funding to $5M+. New investors included Brown University, Mars Petcare's Leap Venture Studio, Incuvate/NQV8, Golden Seeds, 1731 MGMT.

Perelel.profile: Women's health/prenatal supplement brand (US). Section 2 runner-up candidate, 2026-09-28 run -- rejected in favor of Nutrafol on scale/verifiability grounds (revenue-doubling claim is self-reported without an independently verified figure). Leans on Instagram/TikTok community-building per Digiday coverage.

key_facts.fact: Raised $27M growth round from Prelude Growth Partners; company claims revenue doubled YoY and a path to profitability within five years.

Bundle x Joy.profile: Phoenix-based pet gut-health brand founded 2021 by Jess Berger (ex-PetSmart/Nestle Purina merchandiser). Product line spans gut-health powders/toppers (flagship 'Daily Boost' bone-broth/colostrum powder), jerky toppers, and allergy-friendly kibble -- food/treats/supplement hybrid rather than a pure pill/capsule brand. Section 2 Brand Spotlight, 2026-10-05 run.

key_facts.fact: Ranked No. 170 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list; 2,300% revenue growth 2022-2025; reached seven-figure revenue in year one; now in 1,400+ retail doors (Whole Foods, Sprouts, Walmart nationwide since Apr 2025, PetSmart nationwide since Oct 2025, Costco, Chewy, Thrive Market).

Capital-efficient $1M seed backers: Mars Petcare Ventures, Leap Venture Studio, R/GA Ventures, Michelson Found Animals Foundation. 3% of every purchase donated to women entrepreneurs and animal-welfare causes. No lawsuits/FTC action found; minor scattered price/picky-eater complaints only.

Tiny Health.profile: Austin-based gut/vaginal microbiome testing platform. Recommends/sells probiotic supplements based on test results -- a diagnostics-first business rather than a pure supplement brand.

key_facts.fact: Raised $33M Series B led by B Capital (oversubscribed; total funding now $46M), alongside a new $5M Microbiome Research Program. Funds clinical research, practitioner education, and its B2B 'Powered by Tiny'/TinyAI platform.

Viome.profile: Personalized-nutrition/microbiome testing and supplement company. Acquired Solaria Bio (precision-probiotic maker) Oct 2026 -- Solaria's lead product Bondia becomes Viome's first offering sold without requiring a Viome test first, pairing Solaria's biobank/discovery platform with Viome's microbiome dataset.

key_facts.fact: Acquired Solaria Bio to launch clinically validated consumer synbiotics and medical foods.

Sports Research.profile: Sports-nutrition supplement brand. Launched Creatine + Electrolytes, its first entry into Costco's sports-nutrition aisle.

key_facts.fact: Launched Creatine + Electrolytes (sugar-free powder, 5g micronized creatine monohydrate + 1,000mg electrolytes), backed by a 'Hydrate Responsibly' campaign (Diplo yoga activation at Country Splash Cabo) -- first Costco sports-nutrition-aisle placement.

Qualia.profile: Neurohacker Collective's supplement brand (nootropics/longevity-focused). Launched Qualia Perimenopause, its first entry into the women's-health/perimenopause category.

key_facts.fact: Launched Qualia Perimenopause -- a single-capsule, hormone-free, seven-bioactive formula targeting hot flashes, sleep disruption, and mood changes; available via qualialife.com, Amazon, and select retail (product live Sept 29).

Tmrw.profile: Longevity supplement brand from the founders of Simply Nootropics. 88-ingredient all-in-one longevity drink-mix powder positioned to replace a 20+ product supplement stack with one daily scoop (NMN, CoQ10, biotin, choline, inulin, manganese, etc.).

key_facts.fact: Launched in the US with 35,000+ pre-orders and 1M+ servings consumed to date.

SupplementMe.profile: UK, bootstrapped (no outside funding), founded by Tarik Azirar (ex-data analytics). Deliberately minimal 5-SKU range (Vitamin D3 gummies, vegan multivitamin, probiotic, vitamin C/acerola, ashwagandha gummies) positioned against 'choice overload' in the UK supplement aisle; DTC-only via SupplementMe.co.uk.

key_facts.fact: Launched with its focused 5-product range; covered in NutraIngredients' Sept NPD Launchpad roundup.
